body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: 983d0e575a5a15f21d8437e1275a79d0386a0f77 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

This is a DELTA re-review after the refresh merge of `main 16dc39f06` into the reviewed head `4ab08d8ea`. The delta is one UI test-file conflict, resolved by keeping both sides. The earlier two blockers are answered.

### What looks good

- The `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/pass_start.rs` conflict is add/add. The resolution keeps main's `circular_passes_tab_offers_all_three_pass_starts` and this branch's `the_trochoidal_slot_passes_tab_locks_auto_and_explains_the_loop_order`. No shared logic changed.
- The remerge-diff of `983d0e575` removes only the conflict-marker lines. The file has 9 `#[test]`, against 8 on `main` and 5 at the reviewed head. The count rises by the branch's one test. None is lost.
- Against `main`, `pass_start.rs` adds only this branch's trochoidal test. Every test that `main` has is kept.
- No refusal or safety rule is lost. The Trochoidal Slot refusal is one constant (`crates/app/src/operation/trochoid_op.rs:12`), re-exported (`crates/app/src/operation/mod.rs:85`), used by the MCP `patched` refusal (`crates/app/src/mcp/edit.rs:69`) and the disabled Passes row (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/trochoid_page.rs:77`). The MCP refusal is made before any command is created. The generator and the project file do not change.
- The PR body now has all six screenshots (Face, Slot and Trochoidal Slot, before and after). The `Changelog:` line and `Fixes #3358` are present.
- No `unwrap()`, `expect()` or `panic!()` in the non-test additions.
- No process file, `Cargo.toml`/`Cargo.lock`, `build.rs`, `.github/`, `scripts/`, `CHANGELOG.md` or snapshot PNG is touched. `mergeable` is `MERGEABLE`.

### Results on head `983d0e575`

These ran locally, in the refresh worktree, with `CAMCRAFT_GATE_JOBS=3`. They are in the PR body. I did not re-run them, because the delta is a test-only conflict resolution.

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `camcraft-app --test mcp` | 25 passed, 0 failed |
| `camcraft-app --test face_pass_start` | 1 passed, 0 failed |
| `camcraft-app --test trochoid_op` | 5 passed, 0 failed |
| `camcraft-ui --lib` | 1474 passed, 0 failed, 8 ignored |
| `camcraft-app --test first_part_programs` | 2 passed, 0 failed |
| `clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

The earlier red `first_part_programs` is green on this head (PR #3575).

### Targeted tests

- Post or toolpath: no change. The motion generator is not in the diff, so no example catalog suite changes its reach.
- Heavy step: none. This is a `P2`, not a `P1` under the safety floor. Under `PROCESS_VERSION 136`, the heavy lanes run at the cut. No PR is owed heavy (AGENTS.md "Heavy lanes at review"; the "Owed heavy result" rule is retired).
- Light lane: not re-run for this delta. The delta changes only a UI test file, which the light twins do not reach.

### Requested before merge

None. The earlier two blockers are answered: the six screenshots are in the body, and the heavy-owed rule no longer applies to a `P2`.

### Notes (not blocking)

- The Trochoidal Slot reason is one constant for the UI and MCP. The Face and Slot reasons are still two copies each (`crates/app/src/mcp/edit.rs:67-68` and `crates/ui/src/egui_app/pass_start_row.rs`). The earlier review noted this. It is unchanged and not blocking.
- The `P2` label is the maintainer's decision. A misleading message is `P3` by the AGENTS.md table. This is not a review item.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
